basic_details.short_information: The 1st date of walk-in interview is 30 October 2026, with document verification reporting time from 10:00 am to 11:00 am, at ESIC Hospital, Tinsukia, Sector-2, Bordoloi Nagar, Tinsukia, Assam-786125. The walk-in recruitment is being conducted by Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC Hospital, Tinsukia) for 4 posts of Senior Resident against GDMO on a purely contractual basis with a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 1,14,955/- per month.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The recruitment is purely on a contractual basis for a tenure of 01 (one) year or till a regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. All vacancies are under the Unreserved (UR) category. No age relaxation or reservation is applicable to SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates applying for unreserved vacancies. Candidates must refer to the official notification for discipline-specific eligibility of each post. Not exceeding 45 years as on the date of interview. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC and all others as per Central Government Rules, but no age relaxation will be available to SC/ST/OBC candidates applying for unreserved vacancies.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: All eligible and interested candidates may appear for walk-in-interview along with all the testimonials in original and their one self-attested copy as per the schedule, including: Age Proof (Class 10th certificate/Birth certificate) MBBS Certificate BDS certificate for Dental department Two Recent Passport Size Photographs Caste Certificate for SC/ST/OBC & I&A Certificate for EWS candidates (OBC candidates are required to submit latest OBC Certificate as per Central Govt. Performa, not more than One-year-old from the date of interview) PG Degree/ Diploma Certificate MCI/SMC Registration Certificate with MD/MS/DNB qualification No Objection Certificate from present employer, if applicable (No candidate will be allowed to appear in the interview without NOC from his employer; also applicable for Doctors under Bond) Experience Certificate, if applicable FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must report at the interview venue between 10:00 am and 11:00 am for document verification. Candidates whose documents are verified only will be allowed to attend the walk-in interview. The selection is subject to the candidates proving their medical fitness, and in case of selection, the offer of appointment will be issued as per requirement.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for ESIC Recruitment 2026 at Tinsukia?
faq.answer: The 1st date of walk-in interview is 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for document verification on the interview day?
faq.answer: Candidates must report for document verification between 10:00 am and 11:00 am.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the interview venue located?
faq.answer: The tentative venue is ESIC Hospital, Tinsukia, Sector-2, Bordoloi Nagar, Tinsukia, Assam-786125 (however, venue may change based on the number of applicants received).

faq.question: Q4. How many total vacancies are announced in ESIC Hospital Tinsukia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies (Accident & Emergency: 2, Dental: 1, Surgery: 1), all of which are unreserved.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Senior Resident against GDMO at ESIC Hospital Tinsukia?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 1,14,955/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for attending the ESIC walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 45 years as on the date of interview, with no relaxation for unreserved vacancies.

faq.question: Q7. Is the appointment permanent or contractual, and for what tenure?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely on a contractual basis for a tenure of 01 (one) year or till a regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any security deposit required upon selection?
faq.answer: Selected candidates must furnish a Demand Draft or Bankers Cheque of Rs. 30,000/- drawn in favor of "ESI Fund Account No. 1" payable at Tinsukia as a security deposit.

faq.question: Q9. Under what condition will the security deposit be forfeited?
faq.answer: The security deposit of Rs. 30,000/- will be forfeited if the candidate resigns or terminates the contract within 09 months of commencement.

faq.question: Q10. Where should applicants send their filled application form prior to the interview?
faq.answer: Applicants are requested to email their filled application form along with their MCI/SMC Number and contact number to [email protected].
